result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner remains visible over the already-loaded Tokumaru Ramen Bar image. The rest of the page looks correct, apart from carousel and bottom-edge clipping, which are expected.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a loading spinner (white circle with a partial green ring) in the middle of its hero image, even though the image has fully loaded. The spinner appears stuck, covers the artwork and makes the page look unfinished or frozen.
issues.suggestion: Hide or remove the loading indicator once the image's load event fires, and make sure the loading state resets correctly, including when the image loads from cache or on error.
